blockingFindings.title: Normal transition instance is not asserted on the real store path
blockingFindings.rationale: This is an explicit acceptance requirement with no corresponding executable coverage, and the current test can pass without exercising the required transition-instance API contract.
blockingFindings.issue: R5 requires FlowStore to accept a validated transition instance, but the real FlowStore/SetStepCommand test only asserts the final persisted behavior and write count. An implementation could keep accepting raw step/status arguments or mutate directly, while still passing this test.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local assertion on the real normal set-step path that FlowStore/updateStepStatus receives or requires a NormalStepTransition instance, and rejects a raw/non-transition update without mutation.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This is an explicit acceptance requirement with no corresponding executable coverage, and the current test can pass without exercising the required transition-instance API contract.
